items.title: Where Analysts Pushed Back On NXPI's Latest Call
items.summary: NXP Semiconductors says its auto business is a unique growth story, but on its latest earnings call, analysts kept asking why it looks so different from its peers.

items.title: What Is The Market Really Expecting From AVGO Stock?
items.summary: At $422, Broadcom (AVGO) is being priced to deliver 26% revenue growth annually for the next 5 years simply to defend today's 68.4x multiple. That sits below the 32% the business is currently growing at, which is the unusual part. The multiple has already priced in a slowdown that has not yet appeared.

items.title: The Options Market Says Marvell Stock Could Halve Or More Than Double
items.summary: This band is not a panic premium; it sits close to what the stock has actually delivered over the past year, and a holder carries every bit of that width.

items.title: Qualcomm Missed Earnings Estimates But Says the Bottom Is Near. How to Play QCOM Stock Here.
items.summary: Management believes the current handset downturn is bottoming, but investors will need to see further proof before becoming aggressively bullish.

items.title: Apple Already Increased the Price of iPhones Up to $300. Their Price Hikes Might Be Just Starting.
items.summary: Memory costs are already squeezing Apple hard enough that Tim Cook called it a once-in-a-century event, but the worst may still be ahead for iPhone buyers and Apple shareholders alike.

items.title: NVIDIA's Falling Multiple Is A Bill, Not A Bargain
items.summary: Analysts have the earnings growing into the price, so what a holder is really underwriting is the build-out that has to produce them.

items.title: AMD's Bigger Risk Sits In Its Revenue Mix, Not Its Multiple
items.summary: Most of what AMD sells now comes from data center, and management puts the gross margin on the accelerator ramp driving that growth just below average.

items.title: QUALCOMM (QCOM) Issued Q4 Guidance, Is The 17% Discount Enough?
